title: Proximity Without Community
sentences: Living near people has never automatically produced community.
What produced it historically was repeated, unavoidable dependence.
You knew the baker because there was no alternative to knowing him.
Modern cities have removed almost every such compulsory encounter.
This is, by most measures, a substantial gain in personal freedom.
It also dissolved the accidental relationships that freedom cannot replace.
Deliberate community requires effort that dependence used to supply for nothing.
The people who manage it tend to have time, which is unevenly distributed.
So conviviality becomes another good that sorts by income.
We have arranged our streets so that solitude is the default setting.
